answer: A payout is split and therefore 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The orchard schedule is applied in dawn and vault makes public each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3514 identities would post 4811 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
